name: Run VO2 hills 50
description: Five hard four-minute climbing efforts at running speed with easy jogs between: the hardest aerobic session in the library. Needs the console in running mode and --running-mode.

ramp.name: Warm-up
ramp.notes: Easy jog or brisk walk, relaxed shoulders.

steps.name: VO2 hill
steps.notes: RPE 8-9. Strong and steady; do not start too fast.

steps.name: Easy jog
steps.notes: RPE 3: let the breathing come down.

ramp.name: Cooldown
ramp.notes: Walk it off; let the breathing settle.
